name: savings-wallet
description: Multi-blockchain savings wallet DApp with EVM and Solana support

scripts.test: echo "Use workspace-specific test commands: cd ethereum && npm test, or cd solana && npm test"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=ethereum && npm install --workspace=solana && npm install --workspace=frontend
scripts.solana:localnet:setup: npm run solana:localnet & sleep 10 && node solana/setup-solana-tokens.js
scripts.solana:setup: npm run solana:build && npm run solana:deploy && npm run solana:update-frontend
scripts.dev:evm: npm run node --workspace=ethereum & sleep 5 && npm run deploy-modular --workspace=ethereum && npm run frontend:start
scripts.dev:full: concurrently "npm run node --workspace=ethereum" "npm run solana:localnet" "npm run frontend:start"
scripts.deploy:full: npm run deploy-modular --workspace=ethereum && npm run solana:deploy-reliable
